FSL Complex

Source: R/wrappers_auto.R
ni_fsl_complex.Rd

fslcomplex is a tool for converting complex data

Usage

ni_fsl_complex(
  args = NULL,
  complex_cartesian = NULL,
  complex_in_file = NULL,
  complex_in_file2 = NULL,
  complex_merge = NULL,
  complex_out_file = NULL,
  complex_polar = NULL,
  complex_split = NULL,
  end_vol = NULL,
  imaginary_in_file = NULL,
  imaginary_out_file = NULL,
  magnitude_in_file = NULL,
  magnitude_out_file = NULL,
  phase_in_file = NULL,
  phase_out_file = NULL,
  real_cartesian = NULL,
  real_in_file = NULL,
  real_out_file = NULL,
  real_polar = NULL,
  start_vol = NULL,
  .cwd = NULL,
  .env = NULL,
  .engine = NULL,
  .profile = NULL,
  dry_run = FALSE,
  echo = interactive()
)
